text:
Lia: Quick sync — marketplace availability forecast for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need to lock embargo windows and SI cert slots this week. TL;DR: vendor timelines shifted (H200 ~6w, MI300 partial ~4w, Gaudi backfill ~3w). Who's free to triage impact?
Matt: I can take H200/H100 bookings. Can we get concrete calendar dates?
Anya: I'll own marketplace SKU tagging + image staging. Need the exact node labels from infra.
Ben: What's the plan for announcement fallbacks if supply slips? We should predefine a fallback model & region policy.
Sarah: SI integrations team: driver/kernel compatibility is the gating item for us. We need two test kernels (prod-like + latest vendor). Can we reserve lab slots next Tue/Thu?
Lia: Good. Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (now): finalize embargo windows and SKU names
- Week 1-2: vendor image push -> marketplace staging -> SI smoke tests
- Week 3-4: canary ramp + joint comms prep
- Week 5+: public announce (if all green)
Anya: For tagging convention I propose: `redwood:hw:{vendor}:{sku}:{hw-gen}:{region}` e.g. `redwood:hw:openai:h200:b200:us-west-2`. Keeps CI mapping simple. Thoughts?
Natalie: +1 on structured tags. Add `cert-v` suffix for SI certified builds: `...:us-west-2:cert-v1`.
Matt: Can we add capacity reserves on Dedicated so we don't oversubscribe on day 1? Who configures that?
Ben: Ops should allocate a 20% reserved pool per region for initial launch. Then drain by policy if utilization < 60% after 72h.
devops-bot: CI pipeline triggered: `marketplace/staging/images -> validate-compat` (run id: 20240315-42).
Sarah: Kernel check snippet for lab runners — please run before SI tests:
```bash
ssh lab-runner-01 "uname -r; modinfo nvidia | grep -i version"
```
Anya: Put that in the staging checklist. Also add a ``request-id`` so we can correlate logs to the vendor build.
Lia: Fallback matrix proposal (short):
- If H200 SKUs delayed >7d => fallback to H100 with reduced concurrency + price delta + communication template ready
- If MI300 partial availability => GAUDI as secondary for embeddings only, with eval-run to validate accuracy delta
- If Gaudi backfill slips => enable cross-region routing to partner region (pre-approved regions only)
Ben: Draft of the rollout policy (small snippet):
```yaml
canary: 5%
if error_rate < 1% for 6h -> increase to 25%
if latency < 95th_p50 -> increase to 100% over 12h
reserve_pool: 20%
```
Matt: Who owns the joint announcement copy? We need a comms owner to clear embargo language with partners.
Lia: Natalie will coordinate comms + partner legal. Natalie?
Natalie: Yep — I'll pull in partner PR and legal, target draft by Fri EOD. Need confirmed embargo end dates from partners to finalize.
Sarah: Request: SI team needs access to vendor debug builds in staging. Anya, can you grant read-only keys for lab accounts?
Anya: Yes. I'll open a ticket and attach keys. Ticket: #MKP-4217.
devops-bot: Staging job passed basic compatibility checks (images: 3/3, kernel-ok: 2/3). Full report: https://internal.ci/reports/20240315-42
Lia: Next steps:
- Anya: tag pipeline + grant keys (by EOD today)
- Matt: block Dedicated capacity and create reserve (by EOD tomorrow)
- Natalie: draft announcement + confirm embargo dates (by Fri EOD)
- Sarah: book SI lab slots Tue/Thu next week
- Ben: prepare fallback comms templates and pricing delta numbers
Everyone: please react with :thumbsup: if this plan works or drop blockers now.
Matt: :thumbsup:
Anya: :thumbsup:
Ben: Switching to drafting templates now.
Sarah: Booking labs now.
Natalie: On it — will ping legal.
Lia: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after initial staging results. Keep updates in this thread.
